observations: Independently sourced reserve Away: off-white/stone with pale diagonal brush-like streaks and navy fine raglan piping plus navy/off-white cuff/ring trim. Discrete constant-color ink from clean crop [326,800,432,425], sampled 280px and repeated at 98 × 96.4 internal units; hidden print placement is adapted. No source fabric/photo pixels are embedded. Colors are visual estimates. Common-silhouette adaptation preserves the original PNG fabric/alpha and physical round collar.
omitted: Emblems, logos, sponsors and lettering. Original PNG collar construction retained.
